modal_ci_narrow_validated.description: Bootstrap modal confidence interval was narrow and validated by low entropy
modal_ci_narrow_validated.interpretation: Distribution is peaked (most responses in same category) with high certainty

entropy_stabilized.description: Distribution entropy converged, indicating stable ordinal estimates
entropy_stabilized.interpretation: Additional data provides diminishing returns (entropy not changing)

continue_insufficient_history.description: Need more epochs to assess stabilization
continue_insufficient_history.interpretation: Collecting more data to establish convergence pattern
